title: ACwO Twister 515 Wireless Over-Ear Headphones | X-Fidelity Acoustics | 40mm Bass BooMX™ Drivers | ANC 25dB | Dual EQ Modes | 65H Playtime | 45ms Low Latency | AI-ENC Calls | IPX5 - Steel Blue
bullets: ✅ Immersive X-Fidelity Acoustics: Engineered for audiophiles, the TwISTER 515 delivers studio-quality sound with stunning clarity, making every beat, note, and detail come alive.
✅ Powerful Bass BooMX 40mm Drivers: Feel the pulse of your music with deep, thumping bass and rich highs powered by custom-tuned 40mm Bass BooMX drivers for an engaging listening experience.
✅ Active Noise Cancellation up to 25dB: Block out distractions and focus on what matters. Whether you’re working, traveling, or just relaxing, the ANC feature ensures pure, uninterrupted sound.
✅ Dual EQ Modes – Gaming & Cinematic: Switch between high-performance Gaming Mode (45ms ultra-low latency) for real-time action and Cinematic Mode for immersive, theatre-like audio.
✅ Massive 65 Hours Playtime: Power through days of music, calls, and entertainment without worrying about charging. With ANC off, enjoy up to 65 hours of nonstop playtime.
